import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Evacuation {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPS = ROOM;

    static class Aresta {
        int from, to, rev, flow, cap;
        Aresta(int _from, int _to, int _rev, int _flow, int _cap) {
            from = _from; to = _to; rev = _rev; flow = _flow; cap = _cap;
        }
        int residuo() { return cap - flow; }
    }

    static class EdmondsKarp {
        int size;
        List<Aresta>[] grafo;
        Aresta[] prev;
        boolean[] vis;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        EdmondsKarp(int tam) {
            size = tam;
            grafo = new ArrayList[size];
            for (int i=0; i<size; i++) {
                grafo[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            prev = new Aresta[size];
            vis = new boolean[size];
        }

        void limpa() {
            for (int i=0; i<size; i++) {
                grafo[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void add(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, 0);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        void undirectedAdd(int s, int t, int cap) {
            Aresta a = new Aresta(s, t, grafo[t].size(), 0, cap);
            Aresta b = new Aresta(t, s, grafo[s].size(), 0, cap);
            grafo[s].add(a);
            grafo[t].add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(prev, null);
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Queue<Integer> fila = new LinkedList<>();
            fila.offer(source);
            vis[source] = true;

            while (!fila.isEmpty()) {
                int atual = fila.poll();
                if (atual == sink) return true;
                for (Aresta a : grafo[atual]) {
                    if (!vis[a.to] && a.residuo() > 0) {
                        prev[a.to] = a;
                        vis[a.to] = true;
                        fila.offer(a.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int dfs(int source, int sink) {
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int v = sink;
            while (v != source) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, prev[v].residuo());
                v = prev[v].from;
            }
            v = sink;
            while (v != source) {
                Aresta a = prev[v];
                a.flow += flow;
                grafo[a.to].get(a.rev).flow -= flow;
                v = a.from;
            }
            return flow;
        }

        long flow(int source, int sink) {
            long totalFlow = 0;
            while (bfs(source, sink)) {
                totalFlow += dfs(source, sink);
            }
            return totalFlow;
        }
    }

    static int[][] station = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] checkpoint = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] veneno = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];

    static class Coord {
        int x, y, qtd;
        Coord(int a, int b, int c) {
            x = a; y = b; qtd = c;
        }
        boolean is_valid(int N) {
            return (x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && station[x][y] == ROOM);
        }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Coord)) return false;
            Coord c = (Coord) o;
            return x == c.x && y == c.y;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(x, y);
        }
    }

    static boolean is_valid(int x, int y, int N) {
        return new Coord(x, y, 0).is_valid(N);
    }

    static int[] moveX = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] moveY = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int trad(char ch) {
        if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') return ROOM;
        if (ch == 'Y') return REAC;
        if (ch == 'Z') return BAD_REAC;
        return -1;
    }

    static int how_much(char ch) {
        return ch - '0';
    }

    static int bfs(Coord from, Coord to, int N) {
        boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
        Queue<Pair<Integer, Coord>> fila = new LinkedList<>();
        fila.offer(new Pair<>(0, from));
        vis[from.x][from.y] = true;

        while (!fila.isEmpty()) {
            Pair<Integer, Coord> front = fila.poll();
            int tempo = front.getKey();
            Coord atual = front.getValue();

            if (atual.equals(to)) return tempo;

            if (veneno[tempo][atual.x][atual.y] != 0) continue;

            for (int i=0; i<4; i++) {
                int nx = atual.x + moveX[i];
                int ny = atual.y + moveY[i];
                Coord next = new Coord(nx, ny, 0);
                if (next.is_valid(N) && !vis[nx][ny]) {
                    if (veneno[tempo][nx][ny] == 0) {
                        fila.offer(new Pair<>(tempo + 1, next));
                        vis[nx][ny] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static void espalha_veneno(int x, int y, int T, int N) {
        veneno[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int i=1; i<=T; i++) {
            for (int lin=0; lin<N; lin++) {
                for (int col=0; col<N; col++) {
                    if (veneno[i-1][lin][col] != 0) {
                        veneno[i][lin][col] = 1;
                        for (int move=0; move<4; move++) {
                            int nx = lin + moveX[move];
                            int ny = col + moveY[move];
                            if (is_valid(nx, ny, N)) {
                                veneno[i][nx][ny] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        List<Coord> pessoas = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Coord> capsulas = new ArrayList<>();
        Coord bad = new Coord(0, 0, 0);

        for (int i=0; i<N; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j<N; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int val = trad(ch);
                station[i][j] = val;
                if (val == ROOM && how_much(ch) != 0) {
                    pessoas.add(new Coord(i, j, how_much(ch)));
                }
                if (val == BAD_REAC) {
                    bad = new Coord(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i=0; i<N; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j=0; j<N; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int val = trad(ch);
                if (val == CAPS && how_much(ch) != 0) {
                    capsulas.add(new Coord(i, j, how_much(ch)));
                    checkpoint[i][j] = how_much(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        EdmondsKarp din = new EdmondsKarp(MAXN);
        int sink = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i=0; i<pessoas.size(); i++) {
            din.add(0, i*2+1, pessoas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        for (int i=0; i<capsulas.size(); i++) {
            din.add(i*2+2, sink, capsulas.get(i).qtd);
        }

        espalha_veneno(bad.x, bad.y, T, N);

        for (int i=0; i<pessoas.size(); i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<capsulas.size(); j++) {
                int tempo = bfs(pessoas.get(i), capsulas.get(j), N);
                if (tempo <= T) {
                    din.add(i*2+1, j*2+2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(din.flow(0, sink));
    }

    static class Pair<K,V> {
        private K key;
        private V value;
        Pair(K key, V value) {
            this.key = key;
            this.value = value;
        }
        public K getKey() { return key; }
        public V getValue() { return value; }
    }
}
